settings.//: Lighthouse's default profile: a mid-range phone on slow 4G. Most visitors arrive on phones, and this is the harder target.

assert.//: Accessibility is a hard gate (every tool passed a jsx-a11y sweep and the rules are lint errors). Performance and size budgets warn until the mobile baseline in docs/LIGHTHOUSE.md is known-good. Script budget: 350 KB transferred per page. Total budget: 4.6 MB, i.e. 1.5 MB of page weight plus the 3D mascot (~2.7 MB, immutable-cached after the first visit). Owner-only pages (/settings/*) still need an authenticated run (puppeteerScript), which is out of scope.
